difficulty_reason: Prove Quot_{F/X/B} -> Quot_{pi_*F/Y/B} is an isomorphism for a closed immersion pi: X -> Y: after base change pi_T is a closed immersion and pi_{T,*} is an equivalence between QCoh(O_{X_T}) and the quasi-coherent modules on Y_T annihilated by the ideal sheaf (i-star-equivalence); every quotient of (pi_*F)_T is annihilated by that ideal, so the induced map on T-points is bijective for all T.
